article_manifest.title: Douentza: Rural women in the spotlight
article_manifest.original_title: Douentza : les femmes rurales à l’honneur
article_manifest.summary: This Thursday, the Maison des Arts et de la Culture in Douentza hosted a meeting dedicated to recognising the contribution of women to rural activities. Coming from the various municipalities and localities of the region, they displayed cereals from their own production. .

article_manifest.title: Gao: One dead and three injured in an explosive device blast in Edang
article_manifest.original_title: Gao : un mort et trois blessés dans l’explosion d’un engin explosif à Edang
article_manifest.summary: One child lost his life and three people were seriously injured, including two children, in the explosion of an explosive device on Thursday at around 3 p.m. in the village of Edang, Anchawadj commune, Gao region. According to local sources, children reportedly picked up the device before handing it over to a scrap metal dealer.

article_manifest.title: Mali: The FAMA free 24 soldiers held by terrorists in Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Les FAMA libèrent 24 soldats aux mains des terroristes à Kidal
article_manifest.summary: According to information reported by the Malian Press Agency (AMAP), the Malian Armed Forces (FAMA) carried out a military operation yesterday, Wednesday 18 November, in the In-Tebezas area, about 110 km southeast of Kidal. This offensive led to the release of 24 soldiers held hostage by armed terrorist groups. .

article_manifest.title: The Malian army announces the “killing” of armed men in airstrikes near Kidal and Nono
article_manifest.original_title: الجيش المالي يعلن “مقتل” مسلحين في ضربات جوية قرب كيدال ونونو
article_manifest.summary: The Malian army announced that it had carried out airstrikes targeting positions and gatherings of armed groups it described as terrorist in several areas, including the vicinity of Kidal and Nono. These strikes were part of Operation Dogokoloko and resulted in the deaths of several militants. In a statement issued on Thursday, 19 November, the army clarified that, with the support of its partners, the Malian Armed Forces had targeted a camp on Tuesday containing militants and logistical equipment, including motorcycles, located 15 kilometres southeast of Nono.

article_manifest.title: Niono, Sofara, Niafunké, Kidal: The army announces a series of strikes
article_manifest.original_title: Niono, Sofara, Niafunké, Kidal : l’armée annonce une série de frappes
article_manifest.summary: The Malian army is continuing its operations against armed terrorist groups. According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their partners carried out several strikes on 17 and 18 November 2026, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. 15 kilometres southeast of Niono, the army struck a terrorist camp .

article_manifest.title: Terrorism: Senegal calls for an AES-ECOWAS framework for collaboration
article_manifest.original_title: Terrorisme : Le Sénégal plaide pour un cadre de collaboration AES-CEDEAO
article_manifest.summary: The Chief of the General Staff of the Senegalese Armed Forces, who is also Chairman of the ECOWAS Committee of Chiefs of Staff, Vice Admiral Oumar Wade, reaffirmed Senegal's commitment to regional military cooperation, highlighting the importance of strategic dialogue, the sharing of experience and solidarity among West African armed forces. He considered that "political differences should not be an obstacle to West African armies in the face of a transnational terrorist threat".

article_manifest.title: Mali: 24 soldiers freed thanks to a special forces operation
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : 24 soldats libérés grâce à une opération des forces spéciales
article_manifest.summary: According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, this meticulously prepared joint operation began with an aerial reconnaissance mission that identified the positions of the terrorist groups as well as the location where the hostages were being held. Following precise intelligence, airstrikes were carried out in the area of In-Tebezas, a locality located around a hundred kilometres from the town of Kidal.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Counter-Terrorism: Strikes by the National Defence Forces in Several Parts of the Country
article_manifest.original_title: Lutte contre le Terrorisme: Frappes des Forces Nationales de Défense dans plusieurs localités du pays
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 19 November (AMAP) The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. Several positions and logistical resources of armed terrorist groups were targeted, with results deemed satisfactory, according to a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces published on Thursday.

article_manifest.title: Mali: 24 soldiers released after airstrikes southeast of Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : 24 militaires libérés après des frappes aériennes au sud-est de Kidal
article_manifest.summary: The Malian army has announced the release of 24 of its soldiers who were being held in the In-Tebezas area, southeast of Kidal. The operation, carried out on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, involved air assets and ground troops. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) have announced a military operation that led to the release of 24 of their personnel who were being held in the In-Tebezas area, located about 110 kilometres southeast of Kidal.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: Several terrorist positions and resources targeted in Niono, Sofara, Niafunké and Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : plusieurs positions et ressources terroristes frappées à Niono, Sofara, Niafunké et Kidal
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national public that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. . On Tuesday, 17 November 2026, a camp belonging to armed terrorist groups, housing several individuals as well as logistical equipment, including motorcycles, was targeted by precision strikes fifteen (15) kilometres southeast of Niono.

article_manifest.title: Nigeria: Nigeria, Cameroon, Chad, Niger Reach Deal On Military Pursuit of Terrorists
article_manifest.original_title: Nigeria: Nigeria, Cameroon, Chad, Niger Reach Deal On Military Pursuit of Terrorists
article_manifest.summary: Nigeria and three neighbouring countries -- Cameroon, Chad and Niger -- have reportedly agreed to allow military forces to pursue terrorists, armed bandits and other criminal groups up to five kilometres across their shared borders. The arrangement is aimed at strengthening regional counterterrorism operations and preventing fleeing militants from escaping military pressure by crossing into neighbouring territories.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: Burkina Faso Targets Critics in Exile
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso: Burkina Faso Targets Critics in Exile
article_manifest.summary: Junta's Arrest Warrants, Extradition Requests Extend Crackdown Abroad Journalists, activists and political opponents who fled Burkina Faso to escape the junta's repression now risk arrest and prosecution abroad, as the country's judicial authorities pursue dozens of individuals over alleged terrorism-related offenses. Burkina Faso Prosecutor General Désiré Sawadogo announced on November 13 that a special court handling terrorism-related offenses had opened six cases against at least 45 people and entities.

article_manifest.title: Insecurity in the Dosso region: in Dioundou, the authorities denounce the involvement of "local children" in the recent series of massacres of civilians
article_manifest.original_title: Insécurité dans la région de Dosso : à Dioundou, les autorités dénoncent l’implication des « enfants du terroir » dans la récente série de massacres de civils
article_manifest.summary: Last weekend, the Governor of Dosso visited the people mourning a series of massacres of civilians perpetrated by members of the terrorist group 'Lakurawa' in several villages in the Dioundou Department, in the Dosso Region. .

article_manifest.title: 22:03 Mali announces the release of 24 soldiers from captivity
article_manifest.original_title: 22:03 مالي تعلن تحرير 24 عسكريا من الأسر
article_manifest.summary: Today, Wednesday, the Malian army announced the liberation of 24 soldiers who had been held captive by armed groups in the north of the country during a joint military operation with its partners, which also resulted in the killing of several militants. In a statement reported by the Russian news agency RIA Novosti, the Malian Armed Forces explained that the operation was carried out in the In-Tebzas area, located about 110 kilometres southeast of the city of Kidal, and resulted in the liberation of the detained soldiers.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Kidal: 24 FAMa soldiers freed during an operation in In-Tebezas
article_manifest.original_title: Kidal : 24 militaires FAMa libérés lors d’une opération à In-Tebezas
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 18 November (AMAP) – Twenty-four (24) Malian soldiers detained in the In-Tebezas area, around 110 kilometres southeast of Kidal, were released on Wednesday, 18 November 2020, thanks to a military operation carried out by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), with the support of their partners, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced in a statement.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Ségou: Adama Téréta presents the national flag to the Governor
article_manifest.original_title: Ségou : Adama Téréta remet le drapeau national au gouverneur
article_manifest.summary: Ségou, 18 November 2026 (AMAP) – Following a march through several localities in the Sikasso and Ségou regions, including Sikasso, Koutiala, M'Pessoba, Bla and Cinzana Gare, the marcher Adama Téréta symbolically handed over the national flag to the Governor of Ségou, Chiaka Magassa, on Wednesday. This march is part of an effort to promote peace, social cohesion and national reconciliation, explained Adama Téréta.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso Targets Critics in Exile
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso Targets Critics in Exile
article_manifest.summary: Journalists, activists and political opponents who fled Burkina Faso to escape the junta’s repression now risk arrest and prosecution abroad, as the country’s judicial authorities pursue dozens of individuals over alleged terrorism-related offenses. Burkina Faso Prosecutor General Désiré Sawadogo announced on November 13 that a special court handling terrorism-related offenses had opened six cases against at least 45 people and entities.

article_manifest.title: Kidal: 24 Malian soldiers released during a joint operation by the FAMa
article_manifest.original_title: Kidal : 24 militaires maliens libérés lors d’une opération conjointe des FAMa
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national public that, on Wednesday, 18 November 2020, at around 1 p.m., the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their partners successfully carried out an operation to free twenty-four (24) FAMa soldiers being held in the In-Tebezas area, approximately one hundred and ten (110) kilometres southeast of Kidal. . Meticulously prepared, this joint operation began with an aerial reconnaissance that identified the positions of the armed terrorist groups, as well as the location where the hostages were being held.

article_manifest.title: Kidal: The army frees 24 soldiers held by armed groups
article_manifest.original_title: Kidal : l’armée libère 24 soldats détenus par des groupes armés
article_manifest.summary: Twenty-four Malian soldiers have regained their freedom. According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their partners freed them on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, at around 1 p.m. The soldiers were being held in the In-Tebezas area, about 110 kilometres southeast of Kidal.

article_manifest.title: Tahoua: Significant quantity of weapons and ammunition seized in Ibecetane
article_manifest.original_title: Tahoua : Saisie d’une importante quantité d’armes et de munitions à Ibecetane
article_manifest.summary: A large quantity of weapons and ammunition was seized by the Niger National Guard (GNN) in Ibecetane, in the rural municipality of Akoubounou, Abalak Department (Tahoua Region). This seizure was presented to the Governor of the region, Colonel-Major Souleymane Amadou Moussa, on Monday, 16 November 2026, on the premises of the Tahoua Regional District of the NGG.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Macina: Holding a consultation forum to address concerns in the cercle
article_manifest.original_title: Macina : Tenue d’un cadre de concertation pour aborder les préoccupations dans le cercle
article_manifest.summary: Macina, 18 November (AMAP) The Cercle Prefect, Albaraka Ag Amarizag, met in the prefecture's conference room with the authorities and traditional leaders, the defence and security forces, the heads of technical departments, the umbrella organisations of civil society – in short, all those who have a say in the life of the town, as AMAP observed. There was only one item on the agenda, namely discussions between him and the traditional authorities, the heads of technical departments and the umbrella organisations of civil society.

article_manifest.title: Press Release | SN CITEC: Notice of recruitment of associations and organisations of stevedores in Bobo-Dioulasso
article_manifest.original_title: Communiqué | SN CITEC : Avis de recrutement d’associations et d’organisations de manutentionnaires à Bobo-Dioulasso
article_manifest.summary: Notice of Expression of Interest: No. 2026-33364/DG/NPK Recruitment of associations or organisations of stevedores on behalf of SN CITEC 1- Purpose of the services SN CITEC wishes to pre-select associations or organisations to carry out, at its sites, the loading, unloading and handling of raw materials, finished products and other goods, as well as their movement, storage and stacking .

article_manifest.title: Nigeria: The army is authorised to pursue armed fighters up to 5 km into Niger, Chad and Cameroon
article_manifest.original_title: Nigeria : l’armée autorisée à poursuivre les combattants armés jusqu’à 5 km au Niger, au Tchad et au Cameroun
article_manifest.summary: Abuja now wants to target armed groups beyond its borders. In an announcement made in Abuja on 16 November, Nigerian Defence Minister General Christopher Musa stated that his forces could cross the border by a maximum of five kilometres when pursuing attackers. Indeed, according to the Minister, Cameroon, Niger and Chad have agreed to this right of cross-border pursuit.

article_manifest.title: In Niger, Algeria is taking steps to secure its interests in the Sahel
article_manifest.original_title: Au Niger, l’Algérie avance pour sécuriser ses intérêts au Sahel
article_manifest.summary: An Algerian army convoy arrived in Niger on 31 October, marking the first deployment of Algerian troops abroad. A first in 53 years! The last time Algeria sent troops abroad was in 1973, to support Egypt during the Arab-Israeli War.

article_manifest.title: In Niger, a terrorist logistics base...
article_manifest.original_title: Au Niger, une base logistique terroriste...
article_manifest.summary: In Niger, a terrorist logistics base destroyed in the Tillabéry region The Niger National Guard neutralised two terrorists and dismantled a logistics base of armed terrorist groups located near Kobagué, in the Torodi Department, Tillabéry region. This was announced by the National Guard on 17 November in a press release. .

article_manifest.title: Mali’s Air Force receives major boost with delivery of Il-76 transport aircraft, Mi-8 and Mi-24 helicopters
article_manifest.original_title: Mali’s Air Force receives major boost with delivery of Il-76 transport aircraft, Mi-8 and Mi-24 helicopters
article_manifest.summary: Mali’s armed forces have received seven Russian-made aircraft, including an Ilyushin Il-76TD transport aircraft, four Mi-8 helicopters and two Mi-24 attack helicopters, as Bamako continues to expand its air mobility and combat-support capabilities. The aircraft were formally handed over at Modibo Keïta-Senou International Airport in Bamako on 16 November during a ceremony presided over by transitional President General Assimi Goïta, Mali’s commander-in-chief.

article_manifest.title: Nioro du Sahel: The efforts of the FAMa...
article_manifest.original_title: Nioro du Sahel : Les efforts des FAMa...
article_manifest.summary: Nioro du Sahel: The efforts of the FAMa are promoting the resumption of economic activities and transport The efforts of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) to improve security and facilitate the free movement of people and goods are contributing to the gradual return to normality in Nioro du Sahel. . The arrival of several dozen fuel tankers, the resumption of transport links with Bamako and Kayes, and the restocking of markets are all signs of this change after nine months of severe disruption.

article_manifest.title: Nioro du Sahel: FAMa's efforts are helping to revive economic activity and transport
article_manifest.original_title: Nioro du Sahel : Les efforts des FAMa favorisent la reprise des activités économiques et des transports
article_manifest.summary: Transport companies have welcomed the resumption of the service. The arrival of several dozen fuel tankers, the resumption of transport links with Bamako and Kayes, and the restocking of markets are all signs of this development after nine months of severe disruption. .

article_manifest.title: Niger: New attack in the Dosso region, in the south-west
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: Nouvelle attaque dans la région de Dosso, dans le sud-ouest
article_manifest.summary: In Niger, an attack took place last week in the department of Dioundou, in the Dosso region, in the south-west of the country. For the time being, no official casualty figures have been released. A visit to the bereaved families following the terrorist attacks carried out in several villages in the rural commune of Dioundiou This is how the Nigerien news agency reported the visit on Saturday of Colonel Major Bana Alhassane, the Governor of the Dosso region, to the Dioundiou department, which borders Nigeria.

article_manifest.title: Nigeria: The country signs a new military agreement with Cameroon, Niger and Chad
article_manifest.original_title: Nigeria: Le pays signe un nouvel accord militaire avec le Cameroun, le Niger et le Tchad
article_manifest.summary: A new military agreement has been signed between Nigeria, Cameroon, Niger and Chad. It should enable Nigeria to pursue armed fighters beyond its borders. Nigeria now intends to be able to pursue armed fighters up to a five-kilometre strip in neighbouring territory.

article_manifest.title: Expelled from Guinea: More than 1,100 people still present at the Bamako site
article_manifest.original_title: Refoulés de Guinée : Plus de 1.100 personnes encore présentes sur le site de Bamako
article_manifest.summary: As part of the return operations, a lorry was mobilised on 16 November from the Kouremalé assembly site to transport around 110 people, including four to the Bamako District and 106 to Burkina Faso. On 17 November, the Burkinabé authorities also deployed 20 buses, two military trucks and 16 medical ambulances to ensure the care and return of their compatriots.

article_manifest.title: Road safety issues in Mali: 2 deaths and 33 serious injuries on the roads every day
article_manifest.original_title: Insécurité routière au Mali : 2 morts et 33 blessés graves chaque jour sur les routes
article_manifest.summary: "2 deaths and 33 serious injuries every day on the roads". This alarming toll was highlighted by Ousmane Bah Maïga, Director General of the National Road Safety Agency (ANASER), on Sunday, 15 November 2026, in Bamako. This was during a training session held at the Maison de la Presse for 60 journalists from traditional media and digital platforms.

article_manifest.title: Ukraine launched 1,336 drones against Russia in a massive attack before the Trump-Putin summit...
article_manifest.original_title: L’Ukraine a lancé 1 336 drones contre la Russie lors d’une attaque massive avant le sommet Trump-Poutine...
article_manifest.summary: Ukraine launched 1,336 drones against Russia in a massive attack ahead of the Trump-Putin summit. The Russian Ministry of Defence announced that it had intercepted 1,336 Ukrainian drones during the night of Sunday, 15 November to Monday, 16 November 2026, describing this offensive as one of the largest night-time attacks of the entire war. These figures, provided by Moscow, could not be independently verified.
